text.vessel.refit.galley-fire-cover.effect: Galley fire starts with less fuel; emergency work and meals take one fewer action.
text.vessel.refit.twin-bilge-strainers.effect: Flood crises admit less initial water and pumping takes one action.
text.vessel.refit.storm-backstay.effect: Storm supports start stronger and emergency work no longer requires a readied rope.
text.vessel.refit.cargo-rail-netting.effect: The first cargo loss in each voyage is caught and deck thieves start entangled.
text.vessel.refit.sounding-keel-shoes.effect: Careful shoal work takes one fewer action and a forced scrape costs one integrity.
text.vessel.refit.winter-hatch-felt.effect: Winter route exposure falls and aboard floodwater does not chill the courier.
text.vessel.refit.signal-mast-shutter.effect: Named signals answer lure and inspection voyages without specialist support.
text.vessel.refit.sickbay-sling-cot.effect: A berth treatment can spend wool and six actions to clear one persistent injury.
text.vessel.refit.vessel-field-forge.effect: The repair station can smelt and forge carried material while Jomon is moored.
text.vessel.refit.vessel-glass-still.effect: The galley can brew and distil carried ingredients while moored.
text.vessel.refit.vessel-gunworks.effect: The storage station can fabricate guns and counted fictional charges while moored.
text.vessel.refit.galley-fire-cover.drawback: The cover occupies dry wool that cannot be traded.
text.vessel.refit.twin-bilge-strainers.drawba: Strainers do not repair an open hull seam.
text.vessel.refit.storm-backstay.drawback: A failing stay still needs the courier at its physical upper-deck station.
text.vessel.refit.cargo-rail-netting.drawback: Cut netting makes the next loss ordinary; it does not defeat boarders.
text.vessel.refit.sounding-keel-shoes.drawbac: The extra iron makes severe mineral resonance more conspicuous.
text.vessel.refit.winter-hatch-felt.drawback: Felt does not prevent wetness, load, or regional cold.
text.vessel.refit.signal-mast-shutter.drawbac: The visible answer records Jomon on the route account.
text.vessel.refit.sickbay-sling-cot.drawback: Treatment consumes time and material; it does not restore lost health.
text.vessel.refit.vessel-field-forge.drawback: Heavy hot work is unavailable during a voyage or deck crisis.
text.vessel.refit.vessel-glass-still.drawback: Its vessels still need gathered reagents and empty physical flasks.
text.vessel.refit.vessel-gunworks.drawback: Loud work still needs stock for every round of ammunition.

text.vessel.story.empty-watch.premise: The household must name how a missing, injured, succeeded, or simply exhausted watch is carried by the living.
text.vessel.story.repair-share.premise: The hull account has become personal: timber, injuries, credit and remembered work no longer divide neatly.
text.vessel.story.eight-waters.premise: Jomon's household compares four changed places, institutional accounts and its own scars before naming what kind of carrier it has become.
text.vessel.story.repair-share.requirement: four voyages and a damaged or previously repaired Jomon
text.vessel.story.eight-waters.requirement: both household developments and outcomes in four regions
text.vessel.story.choice.empty-watch.w: Share the watch by witnessed relationship
text.vessel.story.choice.repair-share.w: Put the repair into common obligation
text.vessel.story.line.empty_watch.dead: Succession record: {people} are mourned as the watch passes to the living.
text.vessel.story.line.empty_watch.living: Succession record: all household adults still live; injury, fatigue and prior returns shape the watch.
text.vessel.story.line.active: Choose the household's answer; it takes one action and enters the record.
text.vessel.story.line.unopened: Opening takes one action. Deferral takes none; the account remains open.
text.vessel.story.resolve.open.memory: The household opened {story} at Jomon's common deck.
text.vessel.story.resolve.open.result: {story} is opened; return to the common deck to name its answer.
text.vessel.story.resolve.no_living: No living household adult can settle this account.
text.vessel.story.resolve.timber: A physical repair needs one timber lot.
text.vessel.story.resolve.invalid: That answer does not belong to this household account.
text.vessel.story.outcome.empty_watch.dead: The living name {people}; the watch passes by witnessed consent.
text.vessel.story.outcome.empty_watch.living: Fatigue and injury are named before a shared watch is set.
text.vessel.story.outcome.repair_share.physic: One timber lot closes two measures of hull damage.
text.vessel.story.outcome.repair_share.common: The household keeps the scar and shares its next repair duty.
text.vessel.story.outcome.eight_waters.common: Four or more changed places recognise Jomon's shared working mark: {regions}.
text.vessel.story.outcome.eight_waters.househ: Household ties and careful hull repairs take precedence over wider claims.
text.vessel.story.outcome.eight_waters.separa: Separate accounts lighten obligations; each port still judges Jomon for itself.
